const message = $json.warning || 'Unsupported approval scope';
return [{ json: { ...$json, error: message } }];

const draft = $json.draft || '';
const updatedAt = $json.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString();
return [{ json: {
  WhenFound: updatedAt,
  Type: 'WhatsApp',
  Summary: 'Latest WhatsApp draft',
  Detail: draft.slice(0, 200),
  SourceLink: '',
  SourceType: '',
  ApproveLink: '',
  RejectLink: '',
  Status: 'Ready',
  Token: 'WHATSAPP_DRAFT',
  Action: 'messaging.whatsapp',
  ExpiresAt: '',
  ProcessedAt: updatedAt,
  Actor: 'system'
} }];

const text = `Room Parent approval FAILED for token ${$json.token}. Error: ${$json.error || 'unknown'}`;
return [{ json: { text } }];

const text = $json.text || $json.output || '';
return [{ json: { to: 'ops@example.com', subject: 'Room Parent Daily Digest', body: text } }];
